linechart.description: Dates use milliseconds or parseable strings; plotting is chronological and raw rows remain unchanged
linechart.markers: Markers, dashed tail and edge fade
linechart.contract: Dates use milliseconds or parseable strings; plotting is chronological and raw rows remain unchanged. Missing and non-finite values remain gaps. Defaults: 40px margin, 2 / 1 aspect ratio, 1100ms entrance, curveNatural, 2.5px stroke, edge fading on. Loading/reveal and 500ms Y-domain tween reuse AreaChart. Brush uses Date start/end, neutral inactive ranges and a full track border.
linechart.keyboard: Tab enters once; arrows, Home and End inspect data, Escape or blur clears the tooltip. Reduced motion disables decorative loops. ChartLegend layout/overflow are API options; inline/collapse fits multiple entries and folds overflow.
linechart.compatibility: Import shared tooltip and legend from chart-core. Existing chart/Recharts and chart-primitives APIs remain available with their own contracts.
